tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
DeepCool PN850M 850W 80 Plus Gold Full-Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply

The DeepCool PN850M 850W Power Supply is engineered to deliver high-performance, efficiency, and full next-gen compatibility in one sleek, full-modular design. With 80 PLUS Gold certification, it ensures up to 90% energy efficiency, minimizing power loss and heat generation even under heavy load.

This PSU is ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.0 compliant, offering full support for modern GPUs and CPUs, and comes with a native 12VHPWR cable – ideal for powering demanding graphics cards like the NVIDIA RTX 4080 or 4090.

Its fully modular cable design reduces clutter and maximizes airflow, making it perfect for enthusiasts who want a clean and efficient build. Inside, it features premium-grade components and a 120mm Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fan for long-lasting, quiet, and reliable performance.

The DeepCool PN850M 850W 80 Plus Gold Full-Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply is a high-performance, next-generation PSU built to power modern gaming PCs, workstations, and high-end graphics cards. Designed for exceptional stability and efficiency, it features the latest ATX 3.1 & PCIe 5.1 standards, ensuring seamless compatibility with current and future GPUs, including NVIDIA RTX 40-series, AMD Radeon, and other power-hungry components.


With 80 Plus Gold efficiency, durable Japanese capacitors, and a fully modular cable design, the PN850M delivers clean, consistent power while maintaining excellent thermal performance and minimal noise levels. The compact and reliable design makes it ideal for premium PC builds in Bangladesh.
